answer: Each agent may propose trades immediately, but only agents with a stake locked for a full settlement window can collect fees or vote on disputes. The registry binds each stake to a verified payment source, while slashing removes it after proven double-spending. A sybil attacker can still create many names, but must fund each one and keep capital immobilized; splitting a saffron trade across onyx and lantern accounts multiplies that cost without multiplying influence for free.
